_comment: Videos ready to publish to ch2 Farmmer (@farmmer-n9t), oldest first. Read by scripts/publish_batch.py. Each entry names a GitHub Release asset (video_url) so a CI runner downloads it instead of needing the 700 MB file in git. `state` flips to 'published' with a video_id once the upload succeeds; a run never uploads an entry that already has a video_id, so a re-run cannot double-post.
